questions.q: True or false? The defender followed the ball, so the outside run is free.
questions.explain: Right, it's true: the defender went to the ball, so the runner is free outside.
choiceExplanations: Right, it's true: the defender went to the ball, so the runner is free outside.
Look at the defender: they followed the ball to the pivot, leaving the outside run free.

questions.q: The pivot laid the ball back to the fixo. What should the pivot do next?
options: Stand still and watch the ball
Move across to offer a new lane
questions.explain: Yes. Moving across gives the fixo a fresh forward lane after the lay-off.
choiceExplanations: Standing still and watching makes you easy to mark, so the fixo has fewer choices.
Yes. Moving across gives the fixo a fresh forward lane after the lay-off.
Running back crowds the fixo and takes away the forward pass.

questions.q: The right ala just passed to the pivot. Drag them to run for the return.
questions.explain: Yes. The defender followed the ball, so the outside run is free for the return pass.
choiceExplanations: Standing still gives the pivot no return pass, so the wall pass never happens.
Running inside brings you next to the defender, so the lane gets crowded.
Yes. The defender followed the ball, so the outside run is free for the return pass.
